Thank you for your response. We understand that the Dadar branch may be operating as a franchise. However, our enrollment and initial interaction took place with Ms. Sana, who introduced herself to us as an owner while representing the True Fitness brand.

From a customer’s perspective, the distinction between a franchise and the main brand is not something that is clearly explained during enrollment. Members join based on the True Fitness brand name and the representations made by its management, including Ms. Sana at the time of joining.

While a branch may operate as a franchise, it still functions under the True Fitness brand identity, and customers reasonably expect the same standards of service, supervision, safety, and grievance handling associated with that brand.

Our review simply documents our experience as members who joined under the True Fitness brand representation provided during enrollment by Ms. Sana.
As customers, we joined based on the trust associated with the True Fitness brand and the representations made by Ms. Sana during enrollment. Regardless of whether a location operates as a franchise or otherwise, members reasonably expect the same level of accountability, safety, and service standards from any branch operating under the True Fitness name.

“I had high hopes for Iron Addict Gym in Mahim, Mumbai, but it turned out to be a massive disappointment. The environment is downright filthy—unhygienic to the point of being unbearable.

The crowd, largely from Wanjawadi and Dharavi, is obnoxious and makes the experience even worse. While the owner seems like a decent guy, his management is abysmal. The equipment is not only insufficient compared to other gyms but also frequently broken down, with no signs of repair. I joined specifically for the steam room, which was promised but never installed even after nearly two years of waiting. Nothing improved despite my patience, forcing me to switch gyms. To top it off, I lost my membership fees and prepaid personal training sessions.

Avoid this place unless you enjoy frustration and squalor.”

Iron Addict: The Mahim Gym Poised for Greatness

In the heart of Mahim, a new fitness haven has emerged: Iron Addict. This up-and-coming gym, the brainchild of promoter Mr. Adnan and his mother, is quickly becoming a favorite among fitness enthusiasts in the area.

From the moment you step through the doors of Iron Addict, you're greeted by a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The gym is impeccably clean and well-organized, with a spacious layout that allows for ample space to work out without feeling cramped.

The gym's equipment is top-notch, featuring a wide range of cardio machines, free weights, and strength training machines. There's something for everyone, whether you're a seasoned gym-goer or just starting out.

But what truly sets Iron Addict apart is its dedication to providing a personalized fitness experience. The gym's staff is knowledgeable and friendly, always eager to help you reach your fitness goals. They offer a variety of personal training options, as well as group fitness classes that cater to all levels.

It's clear that Mr. Adnan and his mother have poured their hearts and souls into Iron Addict. They're passionate about fitness and committed to providing their members with the best possible experience.

I'm confident that Iron Addict is destined for greatness. Given time, it will undoubtedly become the premier gym in Mahim. In the meantime, I highly recommend checking it out. You won't be disappointed.

Pros:

Clean and well-maintained facilities
Wide range of top-notch equipment
Knowledgeable and friendly staff
Personalized fitness experience
Passionate and dedicated owners

Cons:

Still under development, so some amenities may not be available yet
Located in a slightly congested area

Overall Rating: 4 out of 5 stars

I would definitely recommend Iron Addict to anyone looking for a great gym in Mahim. It's a great place to get fit and achieve your fitness goals.

Such a big reputed gym no functional equipment like big truck tire, Sledgehammer, CrossFit standalone rig, battle rope. Having only cardio and weight machines is very common in every gym even in basic old gyms around . I was in Slimwell gym earlier , even they had all above mentioned stuff at just 10k year. This gym charges 20k-25k for just basic gym equipments. Which also I was ready to pay but where is the uniqueness and no CrossFit area. This was highly upsetting & disappointing. Big NO for now. Atleast deliver as per your gym rates. This gym looks 5/5 , but total waste and incomplete. It’s 2/5 now. All that glitters is not gold. You’ll have degraded your own gym standards. featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Faiyaz
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training at I Flex Gym💪for a while now, and it’s honestly one of the best decisions I’ve made for my fitness journey. The environment is super motivating, and the energy in the gym pushes you to give your best every single day.

The equipment is well-maintained and there’s a great variety for all types of workouts—whether you’re into strength training, cardio, or functional fitness. The trainers are knowledgeable, approachable, and always ready to guide or correct your form, which really helps in seeing better results.🤗

What I like most is the positive vibe—everyone here is focused, supportive, and serious about fitness. It makes you want to stay consistent and keep improving.✨

If you’re looking for a place that keeps you motivated and helps you grow stronger both physically and mentally, I Flex Gym is definitely the place to be!👍👍

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Ishtiyaque Farooqui
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been working out at I-Flex (Dharavi) for the past 4–5 years, and overall, it has been a great experience. The facility is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with a wide range of modern machines suitable for both beginners and advanced fitness enthusiasts.

However, during peak hours, it can get a bit crowded, and you may have to wait for certain equipment. Still, considering the quality of service and atmosphere, it’s definitely worth it.

Overall, I would highly recommend this gym to anyone looking to start or continue their fitness journey.
